rows.title: Selenium supplementation and thyroid peroxidase antibodies: a randomised trial
rows.finding: 200 µg selenomethionine a day cut TPO antibodies by 31 % over six months.
rows.abstract: Randomised, double-blind, 184 adults with autoimmune thyroiditis.

rows.title: Dietary fibre and LDL cholesterol in adults: an updated meta-analysis
rows.finding: Each 10 g a day of soluble fibre lowered LDL by 5 mg/dL.
